title: 云原生治理、数据隐私与 AI 工作流的行业简报
english: Recent updates point to a common operating concern: scaling AI capabilities while preserving governance and privacy. OpenAI reaffirms Zero Data Retention for eligible API customers and previews Private Safety Processing for advanced AI safety. CNCF presents Kyverno as a platform primitive rather than only a security tool, raising questions about organizational ownership and budget. Replit expands software creation through Free Mode powered by GPT-5.6 Luna. OpenAI also reports ChatGPT Ads expanding to 31 European markets and describes NVIDIA teams using ChatGPT Work to reduce manual tasks, connect fast-moving signals, and scale workflows globally. For senior operations and development professionals, these developments connect platform governance, privacy-aware AI usage, policy management, and workflow automation.
chinese: 这些来源共同指向一个核心问题：如何在扩大 AI 能力的同时保持治理与隐私。OpenAI 重申，符合条件的 API 客户可使用零数据保留，并预览用于高级 AI 安全的 Private Safety Processing。CNCF 将 Kyverno 定位为平台原语，而不只是安全工具，强调其组织归属和预算责任。Replit 通过由 GPT-5.6 Luna 驱动的 Free Mode 扩大软件创建的使用范围。OpenAI 还介绍了 ChatGPT Ads 在欧洲 31 个市场扩展，以及 NVIDIA 团队使用 ChatGPT Work 减少手工任务、连接快速变化的信号并扩大工作流。对资深运维开发人员而言，重点在于平台治理、隐私保护、策略管理和工作流自动化之间的结合。
why_it_matters: 这与云原生平台治理、AIOps 和 Agent Infra 直接相关：Kyverno 的平台化定位提示策略管理需要明确的组织责任；Zero Data Retention 和 Private Safety Processing 提供了评估 AI 工作负载数据边界的背景；NVIDIA 的案例体现了 AI 工作流自动化与规模化运营的方向。职业发展上，能够同时理解 Kubernetes 策略、数据隐私、AI 安全和自动化工作流的工程师，更适合承担平台工程与 AI 基础设施之间的协作职责。
interview_expression: I see AI infrastructure as a combination of platform governance, privacy controls, and workflow automation. For senior operations roles, I would focus on making these controls usable and accountable across teams.
